capture.method: Fresh native actors in per-case isolated research subagent sessions (19 sessions, one per case, 4 batches of at most 5) read only their exported public prompt, policies, and response contract. No expected answers, prior responses, or tests supplied. Responses imported unchanged as JSON values. A separate isolated research subagent reviewer checked prompts against policies and responses without reading scenarios.json or run_evals.py.
capture.limitations: Per-case isolated sessions rather than one shared actor context; actual scenario operations NOT_OBSERVED; provider token usage UNMEASURED. Policy regression only, not a performance comparison.
